description: Mycelium Network Oracle — models the global financial system as a living network and detects crisis formation from network topology before it surfaces in market data, typically 6–14 weeks ahead. Maps nodes (markets, economies, funding markets), threads (capital flow channels, correspondent banking, trade finance), nutrient flow (liquidity), stress signals, and dead zones (sanctioned corridors, failed correspondent networks). Returns network health score (0–100), regime (HEALTHY / THINNING / STRESSED_CONNECTIVITY / DEAD_ZONE_FORMING / FRUITING_BODY_IMMINENT), per-node connectivity, thread health, signal propagation speed, and fruiting body risk — the probability of a visible crisis with estimated lead time in weeks. Data: FRED, BIS credit-to-GDP gaps, IMF DOTS trade volumes. The only oracle that reads network topology rather than individual metrics.
name: oracle.mycelium
